game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Ivy Tower, an ivy-covered tower: the spirit seeker must handle vine horrors while practicing lists. Core idea – Index Archery: Hit targets by choosing the right list index, including negative ones.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Ivy Tower: an ivy-covered tower
core_gameplay_loop: In Ivy Tower, repeat each round: Hit targets by choosing the right list index, including negative ones. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the arrows value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about arrows to power up the spirit seeker and open the sealed archway.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 6 (applied tier): Index Archery
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Index Archery' (Week 7 slot 2), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Ivy Tower'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how arrows changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vine horrors in Ivy Tower.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
